name: Daisho-in Temple
description: Daisho-in is the head temple of Shingon Buddhism on Miyajima, founded in 806 by Kukai and long the temple overseeing Mount Misen's sacred grounds. Its hillside complex includes the Kannon Hall, the Henjokutsu cave lined with 88 small statues echoing the Shikoku pilgrimage, and lantern-lined corridors. It is free to enter and open daily, and sits on the route up toward Mount Misen.
highlights: Founded 806; Kukai's Shingon head temple on Miyajima
reservation: None for general entry; experience programs (e.g. sutra copying) may need booking.
parking: No cars on Miyajima; walk from Miyajima pier (~15 min) or via Omotesando.
notes: On the Mt Misen trailhead route; combine with ropeway/Momijidani.

ja.name: 大聖院
ja.description: 大聖院は宮島の真言宗の本山で、806年に弘法大師空海が開いたと伝わる古刹です。観音堂や、四国遍路を模した88体の石仏が並ぶ「遍照窟」、灯籠が連なる回廊などがあり、弥山参詣の道に位置します。入堂無料で毎日8:00〜17:00に拝観できます。
highlights: 806年創建・空海ゆかりの真言宗本山
無料拝観・静かな山あいの境内
